caption:
Nobody admits it, but plenty of parents find the Christmas holidays more tiring than term time.

No school run, but also no routine, more sugar, later nights and a diary full of family. Kids feel it too.

Number 6 isn't selfish. A parent running on empty doesn't make Christmas better for anyone.

Parents, honest answer: are the holidays restful in your house?

Save this for the first day of the holidays, and send it to a parent who needs a break.
